        self._pos = 0

        value = self._parse_expr()

            raise _InvalidExpression

        while True:
            self._skip_ws()
            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] not in "+-":
                break

            self._pos += 1
            rhs = self._parse_term()

    def _parse_term(self):
        value = self._parse_factor()
        while True:
            self._skip_ws()

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_EXPR_LEN = 100
+_DIGITS = "0123456789"
+
+
+class _DivisionByZero(Exception):
+    """Raised when an expression divides by zero."""
+
+
+class _InvalidExpression(Exception):
+    """Raised when an expression is not valid."""
+
+
+class _CalcParser:
+    """A small recursive-descent evaluator for arithmetic expressions.
+
+    Grammar (whitespace is ignored between tokens)::
+
+        expr   := term (('+' | '-') term)*
+        term   := factor (('*' | '/') factor)*
+        factor := '-' factor | '(' expr ')' | integer
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
+        self._text = text
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    def parse(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_expr()
+        self._skip_ws()
+        if self._pos != len(self._text):
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+        return value
+
+    def _skip_ws(self) -> None:
+        while self._pos < len(self._text) and self._text[self._pos].isspace():
+            self._pos += 1
+
+    def _parse_expr(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_term()
+        while True:
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] not in "+-":
+                return value
+            op = self._text[self._pos]
+            self._pos += 1
+            right = self._parse_term()
+            value = value + right if op == "+" else value - right
+
+    def _parse_term(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_factor()
+        while True:
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] not in "*/":
+                return value
+            op = self._text[self._pos]
+            self._pos += 1
+            right = self._parse_factor()
+            if op == "*":
+                value = value * right
+            else:
+                if right == 0:
+                    raise _DivisionByZero
+                value = value / right
+
+    def _parse_factor(self) -> float:
+        self._skip_ws()
+        if self._pos >= len(self._text):
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+        char = self._text[self._pos]
+        if char == "-":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return -self._parse_factor()
+        if char == "(":
+            self._pos += 1
+            value = self._parse_expr()
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] != ")":
+                raise _InvalidExpression
+            self._pos += 1
+            return value
+        if char in _DIGITS:
+            start = self._pos
+            while self._pos < len(self._text) and self._text[self._pos] in _DIGITS:
+                self._pos += 1
+            return int(self._text[start : self._pos])
+        raise _InvalidExpression
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_calc(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    expr = params.get("expr")
+    if not isinstance(expr, str) or len(expr) > _MAX_EXPR_LEN:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    try:
+        result = _CalcParser(expr).parse()
+    except _DivisionByZero:
+        return 400, {"error": "division by zero"}
+    except _InvalidExpression:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    if isinstance(result, float) and result.is_integer():
+        result = int(result)
+    return 200, {"result": result}

+

+_DIGITS = "0123456789"
+
+
+class _DivisionByZero(Exception):
+    """Raised when an expression divides by zero."""
+
+
+class _InvalidExpression(Exception):
+    """Raised when an expression is not valid."""
+
+
+class _CalcParser:
+    """A small recursive-descent evaluator for arithmetic expressions.
+
+    Grammar (whitespace is ignored between tokens)::
+
+        expr   := term (('+' | '-') term)*
+        term   := factor (('*' | '/') factor)*
+        factor := '-' factor | '(' expr ')' | integer
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
+        self._text = text
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    def parse(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_expr()
+        self._skip_ws()
+        if self._pos != len(self._text):
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+        return value
+
+    def _skip_ws(self) -> None:
+        while self._pos < len(self._text) and self._text[self._pos].isspace():
+            self._pos += 1
+
+    def _parse_expr(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_term()
+        while True:
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] not in "+-":
+                return value
+            op = self._text[self._pos]
+            self._pos += 1
+            right = self._parse_term()
+            value = value + right if op == "+" else value - right
+
+    def _parse_term(self) -> float:
+        value = self._parse_factor()
+        while True:
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] not in "*/":
+                return value
+            op = self._text[self._pos]
+            self._pos += 1
+            right = self._parse_factor()
+            if op == "*":
+                value = value * right
+            else:
+                if right == 0:
+                    raise _DivisionByZero
+                value = value / right
+
+    def _parse_factor(self) -> float:
+        self._skip_ws()
+        if self._pos >= len(self._text):
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+        char = self._text[self._pos]
+        if char == "-":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return -self._parse_factor()
+        if char == "(":
+            self._pos += 1
+            value = self._parse_expr()
+            self._skip_ws()
+            if self._pos >= len(self._text) or self._text[self._pos] != ")":
+                raise _InvalidExpression

+            return value
+        if char in _DIGITS:
+            start = self._pos
+            while self._pos < len(self._text) and self._text[self._pos] in _DIGITS:

+    raw = params.get("id")

+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+

+    expr = params.get("expr")
+    if not isinstance(expr, str) or len(expr) > _MAX_EXPR_LEN:

+    try:
